Launched in 2022, the '''Esports World Cup''' (initially known as '''Gamers8''') is an international tournament series based in Saudi Arabia. ''Counter-Strike'' was announced as one of the game titles starting 2023. <ref>{{cite web|url=https://x.com/EWC_EN/status/1637136788111376384|title=Gamers8 is taking CS:GO to the next level|date=2023-03-18|author='''Gamers8'''}}</ref>
